<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ux_client_script"><sys_ux_client_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><controller_preset/><includes/><macroponent display_value="Default">255f779783f21210e9ef58a6feaad32e</macroponent><name>DueDate-validation</name><preset/><required_translations>[]</required_translations><script><![CDATA[/**
* @param {params} params
* @param {api} params.api
* @param {any} params.event
* @param {any} params.imports
* @param {ApiHelpers} params.helpers
*/

    var dueDateStr = g_form.getValue('due_date');
    if (dueDateStr) {
        var dueDate = new Date(dueDateStr);
        
        var currentDate = new Date();
        currentDate.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);

        if (dueDate < currentDate) {

            g_form.showFieldMsg('due_date', 'Das Due Date darf nicht in der Vergangenheit liegen!', 'error');
            return false;
        }
    }

    return true;]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-01-24 06:51:43</sys_created_on><sys_id>4aeac4ed8393d610e9ef58a6feaad3b3</sys_id><sys_mod_count>5</sys_mod_count><sys_name>DueDate-validation</sys_name><sys_package display_value="TaskBuddy" source="x_1529240_taskbudd">9ea39f5383321210e9ef58a6feaad3b7</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="TaskBuddy">9ea39f5383321210e9ef58a6feaad3b7</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_4aeac4ed8393d610e9ef58a6feaad3b3</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-01-24 07:14:15</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>default</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>
